text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Those gates are noble, magnificent.
A place that everyone yearned to reach."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How desperately did I desire that victory,
and how many times was I crushed by the feeling
that it was 'out of reach'?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: However, as long as one does not give up, the road goes on.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Because we keep moving forward,
we can carve open the future—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...! Um...
Today's... training is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it's a mock race, please let me participate too!
I'm not the same girl I was two days ago!

Even after returning to the country,
the members of "Project L'Arc"
are just as they've always been.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san!
What are your plans for next year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ask next year's me about that!
Right, Nakayama?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Don't pass this off to me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, if you take a look, you'll see, won't you?
The preparations have already begun.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Are you aiming for it again, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That goes for you too, Sirius-senpai!
You'll have another chance for an overseas expedition next year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "...El will achieve the ultimate result. As long as there are people who believe in her."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sirius-senpai, will you still believe in El?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Don't ask such stupid questions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Before you take to the skies,
I'll be taking first place.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Haha! Right back in Japan and straight to training—everyone's full of energy, huh.
choice_data_list: Our challenge isn't over yet, after all.
Our challenge is still ongoing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
I'm counting on you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mei! Time to head to the gym—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Shall we begin again this year, then?
"Project L'Arc."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Ah... *ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "I wonder if you remember the results of last year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Many Umamusume other than them
have tried time and time again in the past.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Learning about that history might lead
some Umamusume to believe that
<chrname> and the others are special."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"To you who thinks that, here is what I shall tell you:
'You, too, might be able to become special.'"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In Japan, the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"
is a chain of hopes forged by those who refused to give up.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to be faster.’
‘I want to be stronger.’
‘I want to be the best in the world’..."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...The ones who fulfill their dreams
are those who never stop wanting to win.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, dream big.
You guys are the ones who will make your dreams come true next.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Hey, what about you guys—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Do you want to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?
